parameters.m: <int> Number of target nodes that must be connected to the network.
parameters.n: <int> Number of potential hub sites (Steiner nodes) available for activation.

target_nodes.count: <int> Number of target nodes that must be connected to the network.
target_nodes.coordinates: <list[list[int]], shape [m][2]> Two-dimensional position of each target node on the Euclidean plane.

steiner_nodes.count: <int> Number of potential hub sites (Steiner nodes) available for activation.
steiner_nodes.coordinates: <list[list[int]], shape [n][2]> Two-dimensional position of each Steiner node on the Euclidean plane.
steiner_nodes.node_weights: <list[int], length n> Fixed activation cost incurred when each Steiner node is selected for use in the network.

assignment_costs.matrix: <list[list[float]], shape [m][n]> Euclidean distance from each target node to each Steiner node, representing the cost of assigning a target node to a Steiner node.

interconnection_costs.matrix: <list[list[float]], shape [n][n]> Euclidean distance between each pair of Steiner nodes, representing the cost of connecting two active Steiner nodes in the spanning tree.
